messages:
zoe_marketing: Quick heads-up — Sunset Park microconf is one week out (Wed). Need final booth kit + speaker confirmations and a lean run-of-show. Can we lock owners for each item?

mike_events: I got logistics. I'll handle shipping + on-site layout. Shipping ETA cutoff is Tue EOD.

priya_field: I can own staffing roster and walkup demo queue. Planning 2x people per shift (4 shifts).

leo_design: Working on the banner and one-pager. Will push final print file by Monday morning.

anya_sales: I'll take lead routing — want the QR form -> hubspot webhook. Prefer region-tagging for follow-ups.

zoe_marketing: Great. Quick checklist: swag counts, demo laptop/tablet list, speaker slot timings, benchmark one-pager, lead capture flow, shipping label + booth layout. Low-lift items first: swag order status?

priya_field: Swag status: stickers 400, enamel pins 150, tees 120 (all sizes mixed), postcard one-pager 300. Courier pickup scheduled Mon 10am. Still need 50 extra stickers — ordering now.

leo_design: Confirmed final postcard PDF uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood/sunset/postcard_v3.pdf. Shirt print mock looks good, will deliver print-ready by tonight.

mike_events: Shipping address for courier (use on label):
```
Sunset Park Conference Center
Dockside Loading Bay B3
22 Dock Ave
Brooklyn, NY 11220
Attn: Redwood Inference — Booth 7
```
Courier wants dims/weight by Mon 9am.

zoe_marketing: Demo kit — list what we need on-site: 2x laptops (live demo), 1x iPad for signup, portable hotspot, power strip, extension cords, mic if possible. Who brings laptops?

priya_field: I'll bring 1 laptop + hotspot. @mike_events can you arrange loaner laptop from office inventory for the second?

mike_events: Yep, loaner reserved — will courier it with the rest and label as "electronics". Also adding a small Pelican case for safely transporting the iPad.

anya_sales: Lead capture flow: QR -> short form (name, company, email, interest: hosted/dedicated/private, region). Then webhook to HubSpot with property "event_source=SunsetPark". Tag owners by region: NA -> @anya_sales, EU -> EMEA SDR queue, APAC -> inbound-team. Anyone object?

zoe_marketing: Sounds good. Also want a checkbox for "send benchmarks one-pager + webinar invite" so we can nurture with the narrative.

leo_design: I'll include a tiny CTA card with QR + short URL printed at the booth. Also prepping an 8.5x11 benchmark one-pager that highlights latency/cost vs standard cloud endpoints — needs data call-out.

priya_field: For speaker slot — Marco confirmed? (who's presenting the 10:30 slot?)

leo_design: Not Marco — that's for design. Speaker is @sam_research (we're using a short fireside about performance tuning). Sam confirmed and needs a mic + HDMI. Slot 10:30-10:50.

mike_events: AV note: venue provides basic AV but no HDMI adaptors. Bring USB-C->HDMI + spare dongles.

zoe_marketing: On content: @leo_design please hand off benchmark one-pager to me by Tuesday so I can add messaging lines for launch post and webinar CTA. We'll have a small benchmark narrative (3 bullets) for the press pack.

leo_design: Will do. Also prepping a hero shot of the booth for social — need photographer?

priya_field: I can take candid photos but would love a quick pro shot at 11am after setup if budget allows.

zoe_marketing: Approve small budget for 30-min pro shoot. @mike_events add to invoice.

ops_bot: Reminder: Last-minute vendor changes must be logged at least 48 hours before event per ops policy.

anya_sales: Follow-up plan: sync with SDRs for same-day triage. I'll share a lead deck template for quick handoffs.

zoe_marketing: OK — owners summary: Logistics/shipping: @mike_events; Staffing + demo ops: @priya_field; Creative assets + print: @leo_design; Lead routing + follow-up: @anya_sales; Content/narrative + social: @zoe_marketing.

mike_events: I'll post final booth diagram by Monday and confirm courier pickup time.

priya_field: I'll publish the staff rota here tonight (shifts and break coverage).

leo_design: Uploading final print files now.

anya_sales: Will post the HubSpot webhook snippet and the short form link by EOD — will test end-to-end and report back.

zoe_marketing: Perfect. If no blockers, we'll close loop tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
